description: Latest NEA readings for Singapore, fetched about every 30 minutes: the 24-hour weather forecast (outlook, temperature, humidity, wind, conditions by region and period) and the 24-hour PSI and PM2.5 by region with NEA's air quality descriptor. Pass what: 'weather', 'psi' or 'both' (default). Each part has as_of and the official source. Example input: {"what":"both"}.

what.description: Choose weather for the forecast, psi for haze and air-quality readings, or both. If left out, both are returned.

name: sg_weather_psi
title: Singapore weather forecast and PSI
